name: Codia I
description: Codia I was a Mid Rim Territories planet. It was orbited by two moons, the Codian Moon and another one that was tidally locked to the planet's star. Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi at one point mentioned Codia I in his journals, and it was also noted on a galactic map included in the book Traveler's Guide to Batuu.
